newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt carpet share offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt carpet share offer oversubscribed.

text.p: An offer of 2.5 million shares in Egyptian carpet manufacturer Oriental Weavers was about three times oversubscribed, the company said on Sunday.
Applicants for shares will receive all of the first 100 shares they asked for but above the 100-share level they will receive only 33.6 percent of those they wanted, it said.
Oriental Weavers offered the shares at 58.40 pounds ($17.20) each, plus an issuing fee of 0.25 pounds.
The offer, one of very few in Egyptian listed companies dominated by family interests, increases the company's issued capital to 135 million pounds from 110 million.
